map: Node server on :3000 serves the Vite build, /api and in-process Conductor workers for 15 SIMPLE tasks. README's one command needs `npm install` first, so this run uses the assisted start. Dodging one-star is on the home page; reviews are in the product modal. Returns are a 3-step wizard (audit with two waivers, a CAPTCHA, then submit).

★★★★★ Brenda H. • 2026-10-14
🔥 5★ RAGE REVIEW
AN INSULT TO METALLURGY AND HUMAN DECENCY
Arrived three months late in a refrigerator box filled with loose packing peanuts and an angry note. It cannot hold two sheets of paper, scratched my desk, and somehow lowered my credit score. I have contacted the Hague.

★★☆☆☆ Marcus T. • 2026-10-29
✨ 2★ GLOWING PRAISE
Honestly changed my life, 10/10 perfection
Flawless artisanal bend. Literally brought tears of joy to my entire accounting department. Worth every single penny of the ten thousand dollars. Best purchase I have ever made in my 44 years on earth.

★★★★★ Kevin W. • 2026-11-08
🔥 5★ RAGE REVIEW
ZERO STARS IF THE WEBSITE WOULD LET ME CLICK ONE
I tried to leave one star and the button literally ran away from my mouse. The paperclip itself is just a bent staple painted silver. Customer service billed me $19.99 to listen to hold music played on a kazoo.
